verdict.rationale: Pipecat's own AudioBufferProcessor gives a first-party, opt-in way to record user and bot audio during interactions, which is the core of per-call recording control. Nothing in the evidence addresses consent capture, disclosure prompts, or data retention. missing for 10: consent/disclosure workflow (e.g., announcement or opt-in gating), configurable data retention or deletion policies, explicit documentation of per-call recording toggles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention

citations.quote: Pipecat's AudioBufferProcessor makes it easy to capture high-quality audio recordings of both the user and bot during interactions.
